+    recv: &'tcx hir::Expr<'_>,
+    def_arg: &'tcx hir::Expr<'_>,
+    map_arg: &'tcx hir::Expr<'_>,
+    call_span: Span,
+) {
+    #[derive(PartialEq)]
+    enum Kind {
+        Option,
+        Result,
+    }
+
+    if let Some(kind) = match cx.typeck_results().expr_ty(recv).peel_refs().opt_diag_name(cx) {
+        Some(sym::Option) => Some(Kind::Option),
+        Some(sym::Result) => Some(Kind::Result),
+        _ => None,
+    } && let hir::ExprKind::Closure(&hir::Closure {
+        body,
+        fn_decl,
+        kind: hir::ClosureKind::Closure,
+        ..
+    }) = def_arg.kind
+        && let body = cx.tcx.hir_body(body)
+        && let body_expr = &body.value
+        && !usage::BindingUsageFinder::are_params_used(cx, body)
+        && eager_or_lazy::switch_to_eager_eval(cx, body_expr)
+        && !is_from_proc_macro(cx, expr)
+        && !is_from_proc_macro(cx, map_arg)
+        && !is_from_proc_macro(cx, *body_expr)
+    {
+        let msg = if kind == Kind::Option {
+            "unnecessary closure used to substitute value for `Option::None`"
+        } else {
+            "unnecessary closure used to substitute value for `Result::Err`"

+                        ..
+                    })
+            ) {
+            Applicability::MachineApplicable
+        } else {
+            Applicability::MaybeIncorrect

I have applied the suggested fix, it looks correct to me. I was not able to add new test; I think the test harness doesn't support this. See https://github.com/example/linter/blob/main/tests/compile-test.rs#L223 where `rustfix` would write the suggested change to `.fixed` always.

Testing locally with a crate configured to use local `clippy`:

```
dev@host ~/temp/map_or_else_app
❯ cat src/main.rs
#![warn(clippy::unnecessary_lazy_evaluations)]

fn main() {
    let re: Result<(), _> = Err(Default::default());
    let _ = re.map_or_else(|_: i32| 42, |_| 42);
}
dev@host ~/temp/map_or_else_app
❯ LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$(rustc --print sysroot)/lib" cargo check --message-format=json 2>/dev/null |
      jq -r '
      select(.reason == "compiler-message"
             and .message.code.code == "clippy::unnecessary_lazy_evaluations")
      | .message.children[]?.spans[]?
      | select(.suggested_replacement != null)
      | "applicability=\(.suggestion_applicability)\nreplacement=\(.suggested_replacement)"
    '
applicability=MaybeIncorrect
replacement=map_or(42, |_| 42)
```

Is there anything else I should do?
